pyramiding_rule: Absolute prohibition against averaging down or scaling into an active losing position; pyramiding is strictly restricted to momentum bursts where the initial trade is in at least +$8.00 floating profit and the stop-loss is locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution allowed within 15 minutes of high-impact Tier-1 macro releases, and mandatory ATR(14) volatility expansion confirmation before entry.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate automated partial scale-outs (50%) at +$10.00 profit and trail remaining position aggressively to lock in minimum +$5.00 net.
